transcript: Welcome to the quick start tutorial on the Arrangement Tools and 3D Window Tools. I have an avatar and t-shirt loaded and will demonstrate how the t-shirt can be easily placed on the avatar using the Arrangement Tools. Under the Avatar drop-down menu in the 3D Window, choose Show Arrangement Points. These points are used to aid in positioning the patterns where they need to be. Select all the patterns and move them out of the way in order to see the arrangement points better. Use the Shift-A hotkey to hide all patterns. Some of the arrangement points have a gray ring around them. This indicates that they are symmetrical points. This is useful when placing symmetrical patterns on the avatar. Use Shift-A to reveal all the patterns. Select the front of the t-shirt pattern. Moving the mouse over a blue dot will show where the pattern will be when clicked. This indicates that the pattern is symmetrical. As you can see, the t-shirt sleeves and back patterns are symmetrical patterns and placing one will automatically place the other on the corresponding side. As you can see, the pattern is symmetrical. From the drop-down menu, click Show Arrangement Points to hide them and click Show Arrangement Points. Using the arrow icon will show that the pattern will be at the front of your avatar. Use Shift-A to hide the arrangement points and click Show Bounding Volume. The bounding volumes show how the patterns are placed on your avatar. To adjust the dysfunction of the skate part, click exactly on the 3 cotinus down of the subtitle. You can further adjust the positioning of the patterns. Hide the bounding volumes. Select the T-shirt sleeves and rotate them 90 degrees. I am using the arrangement points to reposition them incorrectly on the avatar. Using the arrangement controls I can orient these patterns correctly. I have changed the pink buttons to make the background lighter. To increase the brightness of the colors I change the colors. Right-click with the purple buttons. I can change the color of the clothes with the red and white buttons. Now I can see the colors.
summary: ```# Quick Start: Arrangement Tools (5) ## Introduction Welcome to the quick start tutorial on the Arrangement Tools and 3D Window Tools. In this tutorial, I have an avatar and a t-shirt loaded, and I will demonstrate how the t-shirt can be easily placed on the avatar using the Arrangement Tools. ## Accessing Arrangement Points Under the Avatar drop-down menu in the 3D Window, choose **Show Arrangement Points**. These points are used to aid in positioning the patterns where they need to be. ### Hiding Patterns Select all the patterns and move them out of the way in order to see the arrangement points better. Use the **Shift-A** hotkey to hide all patterns. ## Understanding Symmetrical Points Some of the arrangement points have a gray ring around them. This indicates that they are symmetrical points. This feature is useful when placing symmetrical patterns on the avatar. ### Revealing Patterns Use **Shift-A** to reveal all the patterns. Select the front of the t-shirt pattern. Moving the mouse over a blue dot will show where the pattern will be when clicked. This indicates that the pattern is symmetrical. ## Placing Symmetrical Patterns As you can see, the t-shirt sleeves and back patterns are symmetrical patterns. Placing one will automatically place the other on the corresponding side. ### Hiding Arrangement Points From the drop-down menu, click **Show Arrangement Points** to hide them again. Using the arrow icon will show that the pattern will be at the front of your avatar. ## Working with Bounding Volumes Use **Shift-A** to hide the arrangement points and click **Show Bounding Volume**. The bounding volumes show how the patterns are placed on your avatar. ### Adjusting Patterns To adjust the dysfunction of the skate part, click exactly on the 3 cotinus down of the subtitle. You can further adjust the positioning of the patterns. ### Hiding Bounding Volumes Hide the bounding volumes. Select the t-shirt sleeves and rotate them 90 degrees. I am using the arrangement points to reposition them correctly on the avatar. ## Changing Colors Using the arrangement controls, I can orient these patterns correctly. I have changed the pink buttons to make the background lighter. To increase the brightness of the colors, I change the colors using the interface. Right-click with the purple buttons. I can change the color of the clothes with the red and white buttons. Now I can see the colors more clearly. ```
